evidence.name: Screen field: Configure restore purchases link
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Configure restore purchases link" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Configure restore purchases link
sections.description: Sets the text for the restore purchases link (default: Restore Purchases). This link appears in the legal links section below the auto-renew label and allows users to restore prior subscriptions on iOS.
